summary: These 18 cases cover every coupon rule using equivalence partitioning, 3-value boundary value analysis on all 8 limits found, a decision table for coupon eligibility, and state transitions for the lockout. They also include integration and non-functional checks. Every computed boundary probe value is used. Two gaps in the requirement are listed in the coverage notes.

test_cases.title: Valid 20% coupon reduces the item subtotal only
preconditions: Cart subtotal 180 AED, delivery fee 20 AED

test_cases.title: Code is not case-sensitive
test_cases.coverage_item: lower-case variant of a valid code
test_cases.expected_result: Accepted; same 36.00 AED discount as SAVE20

test_cases.title: Code length boundaries: 5, 6, 7 characters
preconditions: Active codes of 6 and 7 characters exist
test_cases.expected_result: 5 rejected with a format error; 6 and 7 accepted

test_cases.title: Code length boundaries: 11, 12, 13 characters
preconditions: Active codes of 11 and 12 characters exist
test_cases.expected_result: 11 and 12 accepted; 13 rejected with a format error

test_cases.title: Percentage range boundaries: 4, 5, 6, 49, 50, 51 percent
steps: Create percentage coupons at 4, 5, 6, 49, 50 and 51 percent
test_cases.expected_result: 5, 6, 49 and 50 accepted; 4 and 51 rejected at creation with a range error

test_cases.title: Minimum subtotal boundaries: 99, 100, 101 AED
steps: Set the subtotal to 99, 100 and 101 AED in turn
test_cases.expected_result: Rejected at 99 AED with 'minimum 100 AED'; accepted at 100 and 101 AED

test_cases.title: Fixed coupon amount boundaries: 19, 20, 21 AED
preconditions: Fixed coupons worth 19, 20 and 21 AED exist
steps: Apply each coupon on a fresh cart
test_cases.expected_result: Totals drop by exactly 19.00, 20.00 and 21.00 AED

test_cases.title: Fixed coupon larger than the subtotal never gives a negative total
test_cases.expected_result: Item total floors at 0.00 AED; only the 20.00 AED delivery fee is charged

test_cases.title: Usage limit per shopper: 0, 1, 2 previous uses
preconditions: Coupon WELCOME with the default limit of 1
test_cases.expected_result: Accepted with 0 prior uses; rejected with 'already used' at 1 and 2

test_cases.title: Lockout after 4, 5, 6 invalid attempts
steps: Enter 4 invalid codes, then a valid one
Reset; enter 5 invalid codes, then a valid one
test_cases.expected_result: After 4 the valid code works; after 5 entry is locked; the 6th attempt shows the lock message

test_cases.title: Attempt window: 9, 10, 11 minutes
preconditions: Clock can be controlled in the test environment
steps: Make 5 invalid attempts spread over 9 minutes
test_cases.expected_result: Locked for the 9 and 10 minute windows; not locked when the attempts span 11 minutes

test_cases.title: Lock duration: 14, 15, 16 minutes
steps: Try a valid code after 14 minutes
test_cases.expected_result: Rejected at 14 minutes; accepted at 15 and 16 minutes

test_cases.title: Expired coupon is rejected
test_cases.expected_result: Rejected with an expiry message; total unchanged

test_cases.title: Special characters in the code
test_cases.expected_result: Format error for both; no server error; nothing logged unescaped

test_cases.title: Coupon removed when the subtotal drops below the minimum
test_cases.coverage_item: transition applied -> removed on cart change
test_cases.expected_result: Coupon removed with an explanation; total recalculated to 110.00 AED (90 + 20 delivery)

test_cases.title: Discount shown on the confirmation email and the invoice PDF
test_cases.expected_result: Both show SAVE20 and a 36.00 AED discount that matches the order summary

test_cases.title: Double-submit and concurrent use of a single-use coupon
preconditions: The same shopper on two devices
steps: Place two orders with the coupon at the same moment
test_cases.expected_result: Only one order gets the discount; no duplicate order is created

test_cases.title: Coupon field is accessible
test_cases.coverage_item: WCAG 2.2 AA: label, error announcement, keyboard
test_cases.expected_result: Field has a visible label; the error is announced and linked to the field; everything works by keyboard

coverage_notes: Every one of the 8 numeric limits is probed with 3-value BVA.
Gap: the requirement does not say whether VAT is applied before or after the discount.
Gap: the time zone used for expiry dates (local time or UTC) is not stated.
Decision table (minimum met x active x not expired x under usage limit) gives 16 combinations; TC-001, TC-006, TC-009 and TC-013 cover the deciding rules.
automation_candidates: TC-001 to TC-014 at the API level (fast, data-driven over the probe values)
TC-015 and TC-016 as end-to-end UI tests, with an email inbox API and PDF text checks
TC-017 as a concurrency test against the orders API; TC-018 with axe-core plus a manual screen-reader check
